records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the quarter ended January 2, 2022, our global comparable store sales grew 13%, demonstrating powerful momentum beyond recovery from the significant adverse impacts from the pandemic in the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Stores that are temporarily closed or operating at reduced hours due to the COVID-19 pandemic remain in comparable store sales while stores identified for permanent closure have been removed.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated net revenues increased 19% to $8.1 billion in the first quarter of fiscal 2022 compared to $6.7 billion in the first quarter of fiscal 2021, primarily driven by strength in our U.S. business attributable to strong holiday performance, partially offset by continued COVID-19 related disruptions in certain North America and International markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating margin expanded 110 basis points from the prior year to 14.6%, primarily due to sales leverage from business recovery, pricing in North America and lower restructuring costs, partially offset by investments in store partner wages and benefits as well as inflation.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: (1)North America licensed stores revenue, total net revenues, product and distribution costs, other operating expenses, total operating expenses and operating income for the quarter ended December 27, 2020, have been restated to conform with current period presentation.
